# The Lease Review
> Plain-English review of U.S. residential lease agreements. Free sample report, or upload a PDF/Word lease for a structured AI review — $9.99 one-time.

## Key facts
- Service: informational AI review of apartment and house rental leases in the United States. Not legal advice.
- Price: $9.99 USD, one-time, via PayPal. No subscription. Not charged if analysis fails.
- Input: PDF, DOC, or DOCX lease files (including addenda). Files are deleted after processing.
- Output: plain-English report covering fees beyond rent, security deposit rules, renewal/notice windows, early termination, repairs, entry rights, and one-sided clauses — on screen and by email within minutes.
- Free option: a full sample report on a fictional lease at /demo, and a free step-by-step how-to guide.

## Product
- [Home – lease review before you sign](https://www.theleasereview.com/): free sample or $9.99 review
- [Free sample report](https://www.theleasereview.com/demo): full report on a fictional lease, no upload
- [Upload a lease](https://www.theleasereview.com/upload): PDF or Word, $9.99 one-time
- [Online rental lease agreement review service](https://www.theleasereview.com/rental-lease-agreement-review)
